# Rosenfeld Injury Lawyers LLC News

> News and information hub for Chicago-based personal injury law firm Rosenfeld Injury Lawyers LLC, specializing in injury cases and legal consultation.

Rosenfeld Injury Lawyers LLC is a Chicago personal injury law firm led by Jonathan Rosenfeld and team members including Daniel Kaim and Ethan Armstrong, located at 225 W Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606. The news site provides information about personal injury legal services and client resources.
